{{Top|leg}}
'''Byblos Traffic Central''' was the organization responsible for controlling the large amount of incoming and outgoing traffic in [[Byblos City]]. Byblos Traffic Central was responsible for traffic in a 500 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] radius around [[Byblos City]] before handing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] over to local controllers in designated [[Spaceport/Legends|starport towers]].
